summary:
Lighthouses are the next little celestial bodies. Lightmen all learn this at some point as they become a regular feature of the electromagnetic architecture. They do not become like clockwork, they become like seasons, consistent, rising, yet variable, yet unknowable. It is a shame that the lighthouse keepers have no way to sit down and tell stories with each other, or else, there would be a pantheon of Lightmen, for the sun, moon, and every star.
